scientific_goal: Add the omitted 77 Hz rank-one complex oscillator and identify a modestly better neural model for the resulting smoother broadband remainder at learned diffusion scale 1.
constraints: Use repetitions 1-12 for fitting and training, 13-14 for validation, and keep 15-16 locked.
Use the exact eleven-component decomposition and the same frozen oscillator bank in every arm.
Evaluate every scientific candidate at diffusion scale 1.0 with identical 60000-step validation rollouts.
Compare architecture and calibration changes against a fresh TCN63 NLL control on the new remainder.
Prefer the smallest model that improves energy, PSD shape, increment variance and ACF without losing finite rollout stability.

arms.description: Matched five-epoch TCN63 control on the new eleven-peak remainder.
Three additional low-rate NLL epochs to test whether the remainder fit was simply under-converged.
Preserve one-step NLL while applying stronger endpoint-variance calibration at 20, 100 and 300 steps.
Short-memory TCN control for a remainder expected to be mostly broadband.
Memory-light MLP control to test whether temporal convolution is still needed after peak removal.
